nodes.label: Android Splash Screen Logo (xxhdpi)
nodes.rationale: Android drawable asset for the app launch/splash screen at xxhdpi density (~3x, 864x864px). The image is the stock Expo splash-screen template graphic: a light-gray geometric construction grid with concentric circles centered on a white background, not a custom OPC brand mark. Its presence indicates the mobile app still ships the default expo-splash-screen placeholder artwork; part of a per-density asset set (mdpi/hdpi/xhdpi/xxhdpi/xxxhdpi) so Android picks the resolution matching the device screen.

nodes.label: Android Density-Bucket Asset Pattern
nodes.rationale: Android resource convention of shipping the same bitmap in multiple drawable-<density> folders so the launcher/splash renderer selects a crisp variant per device density. This xxhdpi file is one member of that set, implying sibling assets in other density buckets provide identical content at different resolutions.
